decisions.reason: As a newly launched add-on module in the firm’s core healthcare software domain, it is still an inexpensive option to keep open in 2025, but its lower website prominence suggests somewhat weaker early traction than the firm’s more central offers.

Because the secure healthcare messaging service has its own page, is tied to the KIM 1.5 update, and fits a regulated, strategically important workflow in German healthcare, management would likely continue backing it while uncertainty resolves.
